metadata.title: Symbol of the Guanacaste Skies
metadata.description: Explore the ecology, threats, and recovery process of the Scarlet Macaw in the dry forest of Costa Rica.

hero.title: Symbol of the Guanacaste Skies
hero.subtitle: The health of the dry forest rests on the wings of the Scarlet Macaw. Discover its story, its threats, and its rebirth.

ecology.title: The Heartbeat of the Dry Forest
ecology.description: The Scarlet Macaw (Ara macao) is not just a bird; it is an architect of its environment. Its presence indicates a healthy ecosystem.

threats.title: On the Edge of Silence
threats.description: Decades of deforestation and nest poaching brought the species close to extinction in Guanacaste.

conservation.title: A Flight Towards the Future
conservation.description: Thanks to protected areas and community efforts, red paints our skies once again.
conservation.ethics: Observe with respect. Wildlife is not a pet.
